mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*,b.al_name as al_name FROM al_task a LEFT JOIN al_data_clean b on a.al_id = b.id UNION ALL SELECT a.*,c.al_name as al_name FROM al_task a LEFT JOIN al_knowledge_extraction c on a.al_id = c.id UNION ALL SELECT a.*,d.model_name as al_name FROM al_task a LEFT JOIN al_fault_diagnosis d on a.al_id = d.id UNION ALL SELECT a.*,e.model_name as al_name FROM al_task a LEFT JOIN al_state_evaluation e on a.al_id = e.id ) t WHERE t.al_name!='' ORDER BY t.id DESC

WITH RankedTasks AS ( SELECT a.*,
CASE WHEN b.id IS NOT NULL THEN b.al_name ELSE NULL END AS al_name
CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN c.al_name ELSE NULL END AS al_name
CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL THEN d.model_name ELSE NULL END AS al_name
CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN e.model_name ELSE NULL END AS al_name
CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN e.model_name ELSE NULL END AS al_name
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.al_id, a.al_class ORDER BY a.start_time DESC ) as rn FROM al_task a
LEFT JOIN al_data_clean b ON a.al_id = b.id
LEFT JOIN al_knowledge_extraction c ON a.al_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN al_fault_diagnosis d ON a.al_id = d.id
LEFT JOIN al_state_evaluation e ON a.al_id = e.id
) SELECT * FROM RankedTasks WHERE rn = 1 AND al_id = #{alId} AND al_class = #{alClass}
SELECT t.*, '算法审核' as al_name FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.start_time DESC) as rn FROM al_task a ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 AND t.al_class = 'autoTest';
